segments.name: oral tobacco products
segments.description: Manufactures and sells moist smokeless tobacco products and oral nicotine pouches to U.S. consumers.
segments.evidence: The oral tobacco products segment includes the premium brands, Copenhagen and Skoal , and a value brand, Red Seal , sold by USSTC.

segments.name: e-vapor products

segments.evidence: NJOY contracts with third-party importers to supply all of its products and sells its e-vapor products to customers in the United States.

revenueModel.text: Altria earns revenue by selling tobacco products principally to wholesalers, distributors and large retail organizations, including chain stores, in the United States.
revenueModel.evidence: Our tobacco subsidiaries sell their tobacco products principally to wholesalers (including distributors) and large retail organizations, including chain stores.
